description: This file is a Go source code file that implements a code generator for deep-copy functions in Kubernetes. It defines functions and methods to generate deep-copy code for various data types, including structs, maps, slices, pointers, and interfaces, based on custom tags and type analysis.

methods.name: extractEnabledTypeTag
methods.description: Extracts the 'k8s:deepcopy-gen' tag from a type to determine if deep-copy generation is enabled.

methods.name: extractEnabledTag
methods.description: Parses comment lines to extract the value and parameters of the deepcopy generation tag.

methods.name: deepCopyNamer
methods.description: Creates a custom name strategy for deep-copy functions, joining parts with underscores.

methods.name: NameSystems
methods.description: Returns the set of naming strategies used for generating code symbols.

methods.name: DefaultNameSystem
methods.description: Returns the default naming strategy for the generator.

methods.name: GetTargets
methods.description: Determines and returns the list of code generation targets based on package tags and type annotations.

methods.name: NewGenDeepCopy
methods.description: Constructs a new deep-copy code generator with specified parameters.

methods.name: Namers
methods.description: Returns the naming strategies used by the generator.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters types to determine if they should have deep-copy functions generated.

methods.name: deepCopyMethod
methods.description: Returns the signature of a DeepCopy() method if present, or nil.

methods.name: deepCopyMethodOrDie
methods.description: Returns the DeepCopy() method signature or terminates on error.

methods.name: deepCopyIntoMethod
methods.description: Returns the signature of a DeepCopyInto() method if present, or nil.

methods.name: deepCopyIntoMethodOrDie
methods.description: Returns the DeepCopyInto() method signature or terminates on error.

methods.name: copyableType
methods.description: Determines if a type is eligible for deep-copy code generation based on tags and properties.

methods.name: underlyingType
methods.description: Returns the base type behind an alias type.

methods.name: isReference
methods.description: Checks if a type is a reference type (pointer, map, slice, or alias thereof).

methods.name: generateFor
methods.description: Generates deep-copy code snippets for a specific type based on its underlying kind.
